checks.title: Panic and error surfaces
items: `unwrap`/`expect`/indexing/slicing on values that can come from input, parsing, I/O or a lock: prefer `?` or an explicit error path.
Arithmetic that can overflow in release builds (`checked_*`/`saturating_*` where the value is external).
`panic!`/`todo!`/`unimplemented!` in a path reachable from a request, event or CLI argument.

checks.title: Concurrency and async
items: Blocking calls (`std::thread::sleep`, sync I/O, `std::sync::Mutex` held across `.await`) inside async code.
Lock ordering, `RwLock` upgrade attempts, and locks held while calling out to user code.
`Send`/`Sync` assumptions on types that wrap `Rc`, `RefCell` or raw pointers.

checks.title: Ownership and API contracts
items: Functions that silently clone to satisfy the borrow checker in a hot path.
`as` casts that truncate (`u64 as u32`) where the value is external.
Public API changes that break callers without a compatibility story.

examples.note: checked error path instead of unwrap
unwrap on external input panics on the first malformed file
